1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FacetVertices

4 import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
5 
6 /-!
7 A pyramid is a public polyhedron with one original vertex outside a base facet.
8 This proof-only description introduces neither extra faces nor a triangulation.
9 -/
10 
11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
12 
13 /-- All original vertices except the apex belong to one whole base facet. -/
14 structure Pyramid (P : ConvexPolyhedron) where
15   base : P.Face
16   apex : P.Vertex
17   apex_outside : (apex : Space) ∉ base.val
18   other_vertices : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ apex → (v : Space) ∈ base.val
19 
20 namespace Pyramid
21 
22 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (p : P.Pyramid)
23 
24 /-- Every facet other than the base contains the apex. -/
25 theorem apex_mem_side (F : P.Face) (side : F ≠ p.base) : (p.apex : Space) ∈ F.val := by
26   by_contra outside
27   apply side
28   apply F.eq_of_subset p.base
29   rw [F.eq_convexHull_vertices]
30   apply convexHull_min _ p.base.convex
31   rintro x ⟨in_face, vertex⟩
32   exact p.other_vertices ⟨x, vertex⟩ (fun same => outside (congrArg Subtype.val same ▸ in_face))
33 
34 /-- Every side facet shares a complete original edge with the base. -/
35 theorem side_shares_base (F : P.Face) (side : F ≠ p.base) : P.ShareEdge F p.base := by
36   have apex_in := p.apex_mem_side F side
37   let common := (F.val ∩ p.base.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)
38   have common_eq : common = (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)) \ {(p.apex : Space)} := by
39     ext x
40     constructor
41     · rintro ⟨⟨xF, xB⟩, vertex⟩
42       exact ⟨⟨xF, vertex⟩, fun same => p.apex_outside (same ▸ xB)⟩
43     · rintro ⟨⟨xF, vertex⟩, different⟩
44       exact ⟨⟨xF, p.other_vertices ⟨x, vertex⟩
45         (fun same => different (congrArg Subtype.val same))⟩, vertex⟩
46   have count : 2 ≤ common.ncard := by
47     rw [common_eq, Set.ncard_diff_singleton_of_mem
48       (show (p.apex : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) from ⟨apex_in, p.apex.property⟩)]
49     have lower := F.three_le_vertex_count
50     omega
51   obtain ⟨a, a_in, b, b_in, ab⟩ := (Set.one_lt_ncard
52     (P.vertices.finite_toSet.subset Set.inter_subset_right : common.Finite)).mp
53       (by omega : 1 < common.ncard)
54   have lower := affineDimension_mono (show ({a, b} : Set Space) ⊆ F.val ∩ p.base.val from by
55     rintro x (rfl | rfl)
56     exacts [a_in.1, b_in.1])
57   rw [affineDimension_pair ab] at lower
58   have upper := F.intersection_dimension_le_one p.base side
59   exact le_antisymm upper lower
60 
61 /-- Every side is exactly the apex triangle on its original base edge. -/
62 theorem side_vertices (F : P.Face) (side : F ≠ p.base) :
63     ∃ a b : P.Vertex, a ≠ b ∧
64       (a : Space) ∈ p.base.val ∧ (b : Space) ∈ p.base.val ∧
65       (F.val ∩ p.base.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) = {(a : Space), (b : Space)} ∧
66       F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) = {(a : Space), (b : Space), (p.apex : Space)} := by
67   obtain ⟨a, b, ab, common⟩ := F.shared_vertices_eq_pair p.base (p.side_shares_base F side)
68   have a_in : a ∈ (F.val ∩ p.base.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) := by rw [common]; simp
69   have b_in : b ∈ (F.val ∩ p.base.val) ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space) := by rw [common]; simp
70   refine ⟨⟨a, a_in.2⟩, ⟨b, b_in.2⟩, fun same => ab (congrArg Subtype.val same),
71     a_in.1.2, b_in.1.2, common, ?_⟩
72   ext x
73   constructor
74   · rintro ⟨xF, vertex⟩
75     by_cases at_apex : x = (p.apex : Space)
76     · exact Or.inr (Or.inr at_apex)
77     have in_base := p.other_vertices ⟨x, vertex⟩
78       (fun same => at_apex (congrArg Subtype.val same))
79     have member : x ∈ ({a, b} : Set Space) := common ▸ ⟨⟨xF, in_base⟩, vertex⟩
80     exact member.elim Or.inl (fun equal => Or.inr (Or.inl equal))
81   · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
82     exacts [⟨a_in.1.1, a_in.2⟩, ⟨b_in.1.1, b_in.2⟩, ⟨p.apex_mem_side F side, p.apex.property⟩]
83 
84 /-- Retain only original hinges meeting the base, with a spanning tree among them. -/
85 theorem exists_face_star :
86     ∃ hinges : SimpleGraph P.Face, hinges.IsTree ∧ hinges ≤ P.dualGraph ∧
87       ∀ F G, hinges.Adj F G → F = p.base ∨ G = p.base := by
88   let star : SimpleGraph P.Face := {
89     Adj := fun F G => F ≠ G ∧ (F = p.base ∨ G = p.base)
90     symm := fun _ _ h => ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.symm⟩
91     loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩ }
92   have connected : star.Connected := by
93     rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
94     refine ⟨p.base, ?_⟩
95     intro F
96     by_cases same : p.base = F
97     · subst F
98       exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
99     · exact (show star.Adj p.base F from ⟨same, Or.inl rfl⟩).reachable
100   obtain ⟨hinges, inside_star, tree⟩ := connected.exists_isTree_le
101   refine ⟨hinges, tree, ?_, fun _ _ edge => (inside_star edge).2⟩
102   intro F G edge
103   obtain ⟨different, at_base⟩ := inside_star edge
104   rcases at_base with rfl | rfl
105   · exact G.shareEdge_symm p.base (p.side_shares_base G different.symm)
106   · exact p.side_shares_base F different
107 
108 end Pyramid
109 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
